findings.finding: Completed-ledger validation did not recheck raw path containment, existence, byte count, or SHA-256 before returning success.
An admitted row could pass completed-ledger validation without its durable pre-request intent.
JPEG admission did not compare the delivered image against the frozen expected source geometry, allowing a wrong or placeholder JPEG.
The capture_id label implied a known master even though capture ancestry was explicitly unverified.
The execution README still described rejected Freeze 1 as current.
